title: Cowboy's Traditional Huevos Rancheros
description: A classic recipe for Huevos Rancheros inspired by traditional flavors from Silver City, New Mexico, featuring a rich homemade sauce, fried corn tortillas in bacon grease, and perfectly cooked eggs.

ingredients.item: jalapenos, stem removed, seeds and veins scraped out if heat sensitive
serranos, stem removed, seeds and veins scraped out if heat sensitive
medium-sized white onions, peeled and cut through the center of the root, root left on
dried guajillo or ancho chiles, stem and seeds removed, chopped
Bacon, enough to render about 1 tablespoon of bacon grease
Corn tortillas, fried in bacon grease

steps: Prepare the sauce by boiling jalapenos, serranos, onions, garlic, and tomatoes in water until the tomatoes are soft enough to peel, about 10-12 minutes.
Peel the tomatoes and set aside to cool. In a blender, combine the peppers, onions, garlic, tomatoes, and chopped dried chiles. Blend until smooth.
Pour the blended sauce into a saucepan, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes.
While the sauce simmers, fry bacon in a skillet until crispy. Remove bacon and reserve the bacon grease.
Fry corn tortillas in the bacon grease until bubbly and slightly crispy. Keep tortillas warm.
In a cast iron skillet, heat some bacon grease and fry eggs over easy.
Assemble the huevos rancheros by placing a fried tortilla on a plate, topping with a fried egg, spooning hot sauce over the egg, and sprinkling with cheese if desired.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional toppings as preferred.
notes:
Use fresh ingredients for the best flavor. Adjust the heat level by modifying the seeds in the peppers.
